Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Royal Oak for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, including the free Santa at Schiffer. The events run from November 28 (Santa visits at English Gardens) through December 28 (Royal Oak Holiday Tree Garden), alongside Santa visits at Royal Oak Holidays, story time at the Caboose, the Cookie Crawl and Wild Lights at the Detroit Zoo. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
